g.text: Study A | Paired preference penalties at five-second search
Zero means equal modeled penalties, not zero-cost seating or a presumed optimum. Blank rows have no both-valid pair. CP-SAT is the subtraction reference
only. Settings use different weights and must not be pooled into one quality score.
